Social Media Bans for Kids

Evidence Hub

The Web Young People Want

We rarely hear directly from young people about their online experience. The Lisbon Council convened the High-Level Roundtable on ‘The Web Young People Want: Building a Digital Future on Agency and Equality,’ an opportunity for decision-makers to listen to youth representatives and discuss how to redesign an online world that works for them.
‹ Previous
1 /
› Next

Scaling Europe Summit 2026

Competitiveness remains at the top of the policy agenda, and the work of the Lisbon Council to help ensure Europe’s future is shaped for and by its founders continues just as strongly. The Lisbon Council convened the Scaling Europe Summit 2026, bringing together leading European entrepreneurs and policymakers for a dialogue on what comes next for a thriving European startup and scale-up ecosystem.
‹ Previous
2 /
› Next

Sovereignty in Practice

How to truly achieve digital sovereignty? To answer this question and identify new ways to deliver change, the Lisbon Council convened the High-Level Roundtable on ‘Sovereignty in Practice: A New Path for Europe’s Digital Success,’ taking a deep dive into the potential of smart public procurement, automated compliance and flexible innovation funding.
‹ Previous
3 /
› Next

Cities Take the Lead on Climate Action

There is no secure and competitive Europe without sustainability. As European cities take the centre stage of this transition, the real challenge lies in delivering it under real economic and political constraints. To explore the path ahead, the Lisbon Council convened the 2026 Sustainable Cities Summit on ‘Squaring the Green Circle: Climate Action, Economic Urgency, Urban Reality.’ The summit served to launch the Sustainable Cities Lab, a new initiative to move from what must be done to how Europe delivers.
‹ Previous
4 /
› Next

Trust in the Age of AI Agents

Artificial intelligence is evolving from a passive tool into autonomous agents capable of executing multiple tasks. To map out strategic solutions to bridge the gap between fast-moving innovation and consumer protection, the Lisbon Council convened the High-Level Lunch on ‘The Agentic Consumer: Building Trust in the Age of AI Agents.’
‹ Previous
5 /
› Next

Cybersecurity : Collaboration Is Europe’s Best Response

In cybersecurity, no one wins alone. Real resilience depends on cooperation. To explore how this collaboration works in practice, the Lisbon Council convened a High-Level Lunch on ‘Resilience by Design: Why Cooperation is Europe’s Cybersecurity Imperative and How to Strengthen Operational and Human Networks.’
‹ Previous
6 /
› Next

To Ban or Not to Ban: Kids' Safety on Social Media

The Lisbon Council convened the High-Level Working Lunch on ‘To Ban or Not To Ban: What Scientific Evidence and Practice Teach Us on Kids and Social Media,’ a gathering exploring the best approach to online safety for young people in Europe.
‹ Previous
7 /
› Next

The game Far Cry 3 was recognized as the game of the year according to many publications and has gained incredible popularity among millions of players around the world. But, nevertheless, its passage contains many difficult points. It is for such cases that Far Cry 3 codes were created. To begin with, far cry 3 cheats pc were created by the developers themselves, as well as in previous games. With their help, you can find immortality, endless ammo, skipping intro screensavers, as well as complete ignoring by enemies. Here's a quick introduction to Far Cry 3 cheats: - on the desktop, find the shortcut of the game; - right-click on it, select the "Property" item in the menu that opens, and then find the "Object" field; - this field will contain the path to the main game file (for example, "C: \ Games \ Far Cry 3 \ bin \ FC3Updater.exe.") Now, separated by a comma, you need to add the necessary codes: -GameProfile_GodMode 1 (God Mode - the complete invulnerability of the protagonist); -GameProfile_UnlimitedAmmo 1 (infinite ammo); -GameProfile_SkipIntroMovies 1 (skip intro screensavers); -GameProfile_IgnorePlayer 1 (ignored by enemies); For example, to enter the code for immortality and endless ammo, the following should be written in a line: "C: \ Games \ Far Cry 3 \ bin \ FC3Updater.exe." -GameProfile_GodMode 1, -GameProfile_UnlimitedAmmo 1 " - click the "Apply" button and, using this shortcut, start the game. Another type of cheat on Far Cry 3 is the numerous trainers created by the players themselves. Such programs can give you up to 30 different possibilities: immortality, a lot of money, endless ammo, extra precision, no reloading, a larger backpack, super jump and speed, endless improvement points and experience, invisibility, one-shot killing and much, much more. To summarize, I want to say that for the first passage of the game we recommend using only Far Cry 3 codes created by the developers themselves. Using a trainer can deprive you of some of the fun of the gameplay, because it is much more interesting to cope with numerous enemies on your own.
